activities.instructions: Listen carefully to each passage about people at work, then choose the correct answer.
activities.setup: Listen carefully to each passage about people at work, then choose the correct answer.
activities.tapescript:
Suresh arrived at the power factory early on Monday morning. He wore a neat uniform and heavy gloves to protect his fingers. His first task was to check a broken engine in the basement. He used a bright torch to inspect each wire amidst the hum of machines. After one minute, Suresh noticed that a loose belt had stopped the energy flow. He fixed the problem quickly and entered the details into his official office diary.

In her quiet laboratory in Shillong, Tara worked as a research chemist. She adjusted her glasses and placed a tiny bottle of medicine on the table. Every day, she studied plants brought from the hills to create safe remedies for human health. A small parrot perched near the open window while Tara mixed liquids with a round glass fork. She was glad when the liquid turned blue, showing that her scientific experiment was a grand success.

Tariq worked as a busy journalist for a daily newspaper across India. Yesterday, he visited a public park to investigate an environmental project. Children were busy collecting dry leaves and planting saplings under the warm autumn sun. Tariq carried his notebook in his jacket pocket and recorded a conversation with the head gardener. A house sparrow hopped across the stone path while Tariq typed his news story on a small computer screen before the calm evening arrived.

Soham worked as a photographer at the national history museum. He arrived at nine o'clock and carried heavy camera equipment across the main hall. His job today was taking clear photos of an ancient gold necklace and a stone statue from the fifth century. A curious squirrel watched from the balcony as Soham set up his tripod. He carefully focused the camera lens to capture every detail without using bright lights that could harm the old objects.

Sourav worked hard as a friendly waiter in a busy dining hall. He wore a clean black belt and carried trays of fresh food to hungry guests. During the lunch hour, there was a sudden commotion when a tray of hot soup slipped near the corner table. Sourav remained calm and brought a dry cloth to clean the floor immediately. The manager was pleased with Sourav because he always served each meal with care and politeness.

Surya ran a busy repair garage at the edge of his village. Every morning, farmers brought their tractors and vans to his workshop for repairs. Today, Surya had to check an ambulance that had travelled sixty kilometres over rough roads. He rolled under the vehicle on a wooden board and examined the broken brake pipe. Using his heavy iron tools, Surya fixed the leak swiftly so the emergency vehicle was ready for any urgent future journey.

questions.prompt: What stopped the energy flow in the broken engine?
What colour did the liquid turn when Tara's experiment succeeded?
Where did Tariq keep his notebook while working at the park?
What ancient piece of jewellery was Soham photographing at the museum?
What did Sourav bring to clean the floor after the soup slipped?
Which part of the ambulance did Surya examine and fix?
